preconditions.description: Both root1 and root2 must be valid TreeNode objects.

preconditions.expression: root1 is not None and root2 is not None
preconditions.description: Both root1 and root2 must not be None.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) and 1 <= node.val <= 10**9 for node in traverse(root1))
preconditions.description: All node values in the first tree must be integers between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) and 1 <= node.val <= 10**9 for node in traverse(root2))
preconditions.description: All node values in the second tree must be integers between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if areAnagrams(root1, root2) else stdout == '0'
postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if all levels of the two trees are anagrams, otherwise '0'.
